Maize_Common_rust.symptoms: Small, circular to elongated reddish-brown pustules on both leaf surfaces.
Maize_Common_rust.immediate_actions: Remove and destroy heavily infected lower leaves.
Maize_Common_rust.cultural_controls: Plant resistant varieties. Practice crop rotation with non-host crops.
Maize_Common_rust.prevention: Ensure balanced soil fertility. Avoid late planting.
Maize_Common_rust.when_to_seek_expert: If pustules spread rapidly to the upper canopy.
Maize_Common_rust.safety_note: Always wear protective gear when spraying. Keep away from water sources.

severity_advice.mild: Monitor closely. No chemical treatment needed yet.
severity_advice.moderate: Verify any pesticide use against the current CIB&RC label; seek advice from your State Agriculture Department or KVK.
severity_advice.severe: Consult an extension officer about current CIB&RC label guidance.

Maize_Gray_leaf_spot.symptoms: Rectangular, gray to tan lesions bounded by leaf veins.
Maize_Gray_leaf_spot.cultural_controls: Use certified seed and rotate crops.
Maize_Gray_leaf_spot.prevention: Ensure adequate plant spacing for air circulation.
Maize_Gray_leaf_spot.when_to_seek_expert: If lesions reach the ear leaf before grain fill.
Maize_Gray_leaf_spot.safety_note: Always wear protective gear when spraying.

Maize_Northern_Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Long, elliptical or cigar-shaped gray-green lesions.
Maize_Northern_Leaf_Blight.immediate_actions: Scout fields weekly during warm, humid weather.
Maize_Northern_Leaf_Blight.cultural_controls: Rotate with beans or cowpeas. Use resistant hybrids.
Maize_Northern_Leaf_Blight.when_to_seek_expert: If lesions appear on the top 3 leaves during silking.
Maize_Northern_Leaf_Blight.safety_note: Always wear protective gear when spraying.

Potato_Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings.
Potato_Early_blight.cultural_controls: Maintain soil fertility and rotate crops.
Potato_Early_blight.when_to_seek_expert: If stem lesions or tuber rot is observed.
Potato_Early_blight.safety_note: Always wear protective gear when spraying.

Potato_Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked pale green spots that turn purplish-black.
Potato_Late_blight.immediate_actions: Destroy cull piles and volunteer potato plants.
Potato_Late_blight.cultural_controls: Plant resistant varieties and ensure drainage.
Potato_Late_blight.when_to_seek_expert: Immediately upon seeing the first water-soaked lesion.
Potato_Late_blight.safety_note: Always wear protective gear when spraying.

Tomato_Early_blight.symptoms: Small dark spots with concentric rings on older leaves.
Tomato_Early_blight.immediate_actions: Prune and remove infected lower leaves.
Tomato_Early_blight.cultural_controls: Stake plants and mulch to prevent soil splash.
Tomato_Early_blight.safety_note: Always wear protective gear when spraying.

Tomato_Late_blight.immediate_actions: Destroy infected plants; do not compost.
Tomato_Late_blight.cultural_controls: Avoid overhead watering and space plants.
Tomato_Late_blight.when_to_seek_expert: Immediately; this disease can spread rapidly.
Tomato_Late_blight.safety_note: Always wear protective gear when spraying.

Tomato_Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Yellow spots above and olive-green mold beneath leaves.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.cultural_controls: Use drip irrigation and sanitize tools.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.when_to_seek_expert: If mold covers more than 20% of the leaf.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.safety_note: Always wear protective gear when spraying.
